name: Duel Dojo
description: Single-player sword PvP practice: duel bots across ten skill tiers (LT5 to HT1) in a sky arena, one fight or first-to-N rounds like a tier test. Tiers are calibrated against a real sword tier-list distribution and human reaction/aim research; each changes how the bot aims, times its 1.9+ attack cooldown, spaces, strafes, W-taps, crit-jumps, jump-resets and reads your cooldown. Bots follow normal player rules: 3-block reach, player movement physics, human reaction times.
